newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active in the panhandle area late Friday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $1.00 higher.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 55,000 slaughter steers and 36,300 heifers; 92,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 800 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.50 to mostly 70.00. Select, few choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 69.00. Pen select and choice 1-3 1050 lbs Corrienties 66.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 69.50 to mostly 70.00. Select, few choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 69.00. utility to choice 2-4 1000-1100 lbs including Heiferettes 66.00-68.00.
